idea-plugin.name: HAProxy Language Support
idea-plugin.description:
Version-aware HAProxy configuration support for JetBrains IDEs. Catch config mistakes while editing instead of when HAProxy refuses to reload.

Powered by the same language server as the HAProxy Config extension for VS Code (also on Open VSX).

Features:
  • Syntax highlighting for sections, directives, ACLs, addresses, ports and timeouts.
  • Validation against the HAProxy version you run (2.4 to 3.4): unknown directives, wrong sections, out-of-range ports, unitless timeouts, deprecated options and undefined backends.
  • Context-aware completion for directives and option variants.
  • Hover documentation with signature, valid sections and the version that introduced the directive.
  • Go to definition and rename for backends.
Files are recognized by name (haproxy.cfg, haproxy.conf, haproxy*.cfg, .cfg/.conf inside a haproxy/ directory) and by HAProxy section headers in other .cfg/.conf files that no other plugin claims.

Requirements: Node.js (LTS) runs the language server. It is taken from PATH, or from Settings | Languages & Frameworks | HAProxy, where you also choose the HAProxy version. Without Node.js, syntax highlighting still works.

Guide: gmmhub.net/haproxy-config-check · Source and issues: GitHub
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.1
  • Fixed: the Node.js lookup on PATH no longer uses a platform API scheduled for removal.
  • Supported IDE range capped at 2026.2; 2026.3 and later get the 0.2 line.
  • CI maintenance: pinned and updated workflow actions and the Gradle wrapper.
0.1.0 - first release
  • Syntax highlighting, version-aware validation, completion, hover documentation, go to definition and rename through the HAProxy Config language server 0.6.1.
  • Settings page for the HAProxy version (2.4 to 3.4) and the Node.js executable.
  • Detection of HAProxy files by name and by section headers.
  • Warning with a shortcut to the settings when Node.js cannot be found.
